caption:
A zombie and an alien fight over one donut.
Seedance 2.5 froze time for this showdown.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: ultra-photorealistic live-action night comedy with practical prosthetic creature makeup, shot on a cinema camera with wide-to-normal lenses, shallow depth of field on close-ups. Light: cold overhead fluorescent tubes, a warm amber glow from the display case on faces and on the donut, a red traffic light and red neon bleeding through rain-streaked windows; cool teal-grey grade. Camera feel: low angles, a long near-static hold during the time freeze, controlled handheld and fast whip pans in the fight. Pacing: a 12-second frozen-time stare-down, a frantic 9-second chase-fight, a quiet handshake, then time snaps back. Real time, no slow motion. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos, no legible signage: the menu boards are blank glowing panels.

CHARACTERS:
- THE ZOMBIE: very tall (6 ft 2), gaunt, rail-thin man. Grey-green mottled skin with dry cracked patches, sunken eye sockets, cloudy pale eyes, thin lips over yellowed teeth, lank stringy dark-brown shoulder-length hair. Torn navy-blue short-sleeve security shirt with a round yellow-and-blue patch on the left shoulder and a small badge on the chest, ragged navy knee-length shorts, long bony grey arms and legs. Signature: one foot bare and grey, the other in a black sneaker. No blood, no wounds.
- THE ALIEN: small (4 ft 10) and slender. Smooth pale grey-lilac skin, a large smooth bald bulbous cranium, huge glossy black almond eyes, tiny nostril slits, a small lipless mouth, long thin four-fingered hands, bare grey feet. Wears an oversized bright-yellow rain poncho with the hood up for most of the clip. Signature: a small black camera on a thin cross-body strap.
- FROZEN BYSTANDERS: a young cashier with auburn hair in a ponytail and a white T-shirt with a small red chest logo, behind the counter; a middle-aged man in a dark olive jacket, dark knit beanie and jeans sitting on a stool at the counter; three or four night customers in dark jackets and caps in the booths (one is a bald older man). From 00:01 to 00:28 they are frozen statues: no blinking, no movement.

LOCATION: a narrow 24-hour donut diner at 2 AM. Cream tile floor; a long counter with chrome stools topped in dark red vinyl; along the right side a long lit glass display case with angled front glass and empty stainless-steel trays, except exactly ONE glazed ring donut on a white paper doily. Dark red vinyl booths along a wall of big windows, heavy rain streaking down the glass, a blurred red traffic light outside, a glowing red neon sign in the window. Long fluorescent tube lights on the ceiling, blank glowing menu boards above the counter.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:11.8) — The freeze. Opens wide and low from beside the display case, looking down the counter: a hand reaching in from the top right knocks a white paper coffee cup off the counter edge in front of the seated man in the beanie; the cup flips upside down and coffee pours out; behind the counter the cashier gasps, mouth wide open. Sound drops out and everything freezes. The camera keeps moving: a smooth low dolly down and push-in along the glass case (00:00.5-00:02.0) as the zombie's head enters from the left and the donut slides into the lower frame. From 00:02.0, a near-locked close-up beside the angled glass: the zombie hunched over on the left, the alien crouched right under his chin with its face just below his, both staring hungrily at the donut on its doily in the lower right, amber case light on their faces. MUST SHOW: the coffee frozen in mid-air as a glossy orange-brown ribbon hanging from the top of frame between them and the glass. MUST SHOW: the alien's face reflected in the angled glass on the right, so a second alien face appears behind the donut. In the background the cashier is frozen mid-gasp. Only tiny breathing moves; very slow push-in. At 00:11.0 the zombie lifts his head; at 00:11.5 he lunges forward swinging a long arm as the alien drops out of frame bottom left.

SHOT 2 (00:11.8-00:13.3) — Scramble. Fast handheld at knee height, looking back toward the booths: the zombie lunges low across the floor with a long reaching arm; the alien, poncho flapping, skids on the wet tile between the stools and sprints barefoot left to right under his arm; the camera whip pans with it toward the counter. The frozen customers in the booths do not react.

SHOT 3 (00:13.3-00:16.0) — Onto the counter. Medium-wide down the counter, display case on the right edge of frame: the alien vaults up onto the counter, scrambling over the frozen seated man in the beanie, and crouches behind his shoulders, hood up; the zombie stumbles after it, arms reaching.

SHOT 4 (00:16.0-00:18.4) — The face-off. Same axis, slightly wider, locked-off: the zombie squares up on the tile in a wide crouched fighter stance, swinging and slapping at the air; the alien, standing on the counter behind the frozen man, bobs and swats back with its long hands. At 00:18.0 the alien springs off the counter.

SHOT 5 (00:18.4-00:19.3) — Stool hop. Angle from the booths toward the end of the counter: the alien hops from stool to stool, the zombie lurching after it, the frozen cashier on the right still gasping with her mouth wide open.

SHOT 6 (00:19.3-00:20.4) — The flip. Wide, low angle toward the rain-streaked windows and the glowing red neon sign: the alien leaps high, somersaults over the zombie's swinging arm, touches down on a booth table and springs off again; the booth customers sit frozen.

SHOT 7 (00:20.4-00:21.4) — Whip back. Fast whip pan back past the gasping cashier to the counter axis: the alien drops through the air toward the display case, poncho billowing, the zombie swinging after it.

SHOT 8 (00:21.4-00:28.3) — The truce. Back at the display case, close-medium at eye level from the end of the counter: both slam to a stop at the glass, the zombie bent over on the left, the alien on the right; at 00:22.5 the alien's hood flops back, revealing its bald head and the camera on its chest. They catch their breath, the frozen coffee ribbon still hanging between them, the donut glowing in the lower-center foreground. At 00:24.5 the zombie slowly holds out his grey hand; at 00:26.0 they shake hands, four lilac fingers wrapped around a grey palm. Micro pause; both pairs of eyes flick down to the donut. At 00:27.8 both lunge for it.

SHOT 9 (00:28.3-00:30.1) — Time resumes. Cut to a closer low angle at the open case: the zombie and the alien pressed forehead to forehead, both gripping the one donut on its tray with their long fingers, both grinning. The world unfreezes: the coffee ribbon is gone, the man in the beanie behind them turns to stare, the cashier in the top right stares. Red light glows on the edge of the case. Hold to the end.

SOUND: Diegetic sound only, no music. 00:00-00:01: fridge hum, rain on the windows, the cup tipping and coffee splashing, then everything drops to near-silence for the freeze. During the freeze (until 00:28.3) only the two leads make sound: breathing, a dry zombie groan, a sneaker squeak and bare-foot slaps on wet tile, poncho crackle, stool scrapes and squeaks, whooshes of swinging arms, a soft thud as the alien lands. Dialogue in English, dry deadpan, during Shot 1 while they stare at the donut: ALIEN (light, clipped, faint electronic flutter): "I have crossed four galaxies for this donut." ZOMBIE (deep, gravelly, slow): "I... died... for this donut." ALIEN: "That is not the same thing." During Shot 8, catching their breath: ALIEN: "Share?" ZOMBIE: "Share." At 00:28.3 rain, fridge hum and a coffee splash slam back in and the customers gasp.
prompt_short: Photoreal 2 AM donut diner, rain outside. Time freezes mid coffee spill; a gaunt zombie security guard and a tiny alien in a yellow poncho fight over the last glazed donut among frozen customers, shake hands, then both grab it as time resumes.
